info.title: CancerInfo API
info.description:
A free, structured, global, source-transparent public REST API aggregating normalized cancer knowledge with fact-level provenance from authoritative health organizations.

**Medical Disclaimer:** CancerInfo API provides public informational data aggregated from authoritative health organizations for developers and researchers. It does not provide medical diagnosis, personal treatment recommendations, individualized drug selection or dosage, or replace licensed medical professionals.

Information from the NHS website is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Unchanged excerpts carry their copy date and original source link. No NHS endorsement is implied. A paid service must not levy a specific charge for NHS content. Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Use of this material and its links does not imply endorsement by CDC, ATSDR, HHS or the United States Government of CancerInfo, its users, companies, products or services. The original material is available on the CDC website for no charge. Preserve substantive content, source attribution and this notice; do not use agency logos or frame CDC pages. Content from the World Health Organization (WHO) is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 IGO license (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/igo/). WHO content is served only for approved noncommercial use, never on the commercial access path, and always with its source attribution. No WHO endorsement is implied.

get.description: List all canonical cancers with pagination and optional anatomical site filtering.

Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific cancer.
Accepts slug, UUID, canonical name, or recognized alias (e.g. 'breast-cancer', 'bowel-cancer', 'CRC').
List all knowledge sections/categories available for this cancer with record counts and countries.
List all authoritative sources that have provided verified records for this cancer.
Historical version audit log for content records of this cancer.

Retrieve normalized content records with full fact-level provenance for a specific cancer and category.
Example: `/v1/cancers/breast-cancer/symptoms?country=US`

Search across canonical cancer names, aliases, and fact-level content records.
Understands canonical names, abbreviations, and common names.
